scope: The 85-ray Cox ordering is the corrected physical h11=81 phase, not the five-parameter mirror phase.
Patch masks are complements of the four-ray maximal cones and give 81 gauge-fixing coordinates per patch.
The ten coefficients are the implemented truncated orientifold polynomial snapshot, not reconstructed flux-root coefficients with an interval enclosure.
This artifact is sufficient to test the cymetric MCMC hypersurface sampler, but not to construct the physical Kähler reference metric.
No metric-learning or physical open-field inference follows from this adapter alone.
